lines.text: Aaron's sons were Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar, but Nadab and Abihu died before their father did.
David divided Aaron's descendants with help from Zadok and Ahimelech, and Eleazar's line had sixteen family heads to Ithamar's eight.
The families were divided by lot, and Shemaiah the scribe recorded their names in front of the prophet and the officers.
The first lot fell to Jehoiarib and the twenty-fourth to Maaziah, following regulations from their forefather Levi.
The rest of Levi's descendants were listed by family, and they also cast lots in the presence of King David.
